source.source_title: Aransas and Matagorda Island National Wildlife Refuges
source.why_this_clip: A pale ghost crab fills the frame facing the camera on sand and works its two claws up to its mouth, raising the left claw highest around 6.75 s. The crab shot starts after the cut at 5.25 s and runs to the end of the clip; earlier shots show a horned lizard and a raccoon.
